title: Workflow production source universe (v1)
description: Shape written by scripts/resolveProductionSourceUniverse.mjs to workflow-production-source-baseline-v1.json (regenerable, evidence-backed) and workflow-production-source-live-v1.json (regenerated every run), and by scripts/generatePregateProductionSourceBaseline.mjs to workflow-production-source-pregate-v1.json (immutable; adds pregateGitRef/pregateGitSha). Enforced by hand-rolled structural checks in those scripts rather than a JSON-Schema validator library, since this project has no ajv dependency; keep the two in sync by hand.

pregateGitRef.description: Pre-gate snapshot only: the ref passed to generatePregateProductionSourceBaseline.mjs.

pregateGitSha.description: Pre-gate snapshot only: the resolved full commit SHA the snapshot was frozen at.

files.description: Bundled TS/JS production sources reachable from src/extension.ts via the shared esbuild.config.js options.

path.description: Repo-relative, POSIX-separated path. Never src/test/**, *.test.*, *.spec.*, test-stubs/**, or test-fixtures/**, except the single documented exception for package.json (read at runtime for version metadata).

shippedAssets.description: Non-bundled shipped files classified by scripts/lib/productionSourceScan.mjs: package.json contribution/icon-referenced images, and resources/prompts/*.md runtime-resource copies read via vscode.workspace.fs at runtime.
